svg.title: Contextual Long Arrows
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 16 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Long arrows grow with start, middle, and end sequence glyphs.
长箭头用起始、延展和结尾片段自然变长。

g.text: Short fixed ligatures such as ->, =>, -->, and ==> still win where appropriate.
->、=>、-->、==> 等短固定连字仍优先生效。
